events.verdict: Houstan (ORL) extends his arms into Wilson (BKN), illegally moving him off of his spot.
Johnson (BKN) obtains a legal guarding position in da Silva's (ORL) path and is dislodged from his position. An offensive foul on da Silva should be called instead of a blocking foul on Johnson.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) leans into Thomas (BKN) as he establishes himself in a screening position and the contact is marginal.
Houstan (ORL) briefly engages with Thomas (BKN) and the contact is marginal as the pass is thrown out of reach.
Simmons (BKN) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Caldwell-Pope (ORL) during his driving shot attempt.
Wilson (BKN) extends his arm backwards and holds Bitadze (ORL), affecting his ability to get to the rebound.
da Silva (ORL) legally contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Thomas (BKN) upon returning to the floor.

Replay review of the foul called on Caldwell-Pope (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Caldwell-Pope (ORL) extends his forearm into Wilson (BKN) during the loose ball, causing him to lose his balance.
da Silva (ORL) moves alongside of Johnson's (BKN) path and as Johnson attempts to move around him, the contact is marginal.
da Silva (ORL) legally contests Thomas's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
